aid.name: Aid
vsm: a tiny strip of white cloth

desc.desc: Your spell bolsters your allies with toughness and resolve. Choose up to 3 creatures within range. Each target's HP maximum and current HP increase by {*} for the duration.

arcane-lock.name: Arcane Lock
vsm: gold dust worth at least 25 gp, which the spell consumes

desc.desc: You touch a closed door, window, gate, chest, or other entryway, and it becomes locked. Only you and the creatures you designate when you cast this spell are able to open the object normally.

You may set a password that, when spoken within 5ft. of the object, suppresses this spell for 1 minute. Otherwise, it is impassable until it is broken, or the spell is dispelled or suppressed. Casting Knock on the object suppresses Arcane Lock for 10 minutes.
While affected by this spell, the object is more difficult to break or force open; the DC to break it or pick any locks on it increases by 10.

armaments-of-annihilation.name: Armaments of Annihilation
vsm: a set of bullet casings

desc.desc: You summon the armaments of annihilation, cosmic weapons existing of a cannon and a battery. The cannon is mounted on your shoulder (but has no weight), and the battery takes up a 5ft. by 5ft. space up to 10ft. away from you. The battery can be picked up and thrown or otherwise moved.

The battery can be damaged by all creatures, storing all of the damage done to it, as long as it's on the battlefield, as energy. The battery has infinite hitpoints and cannot be destroyed. Additionally, the battery only takes half damage from falling damage. As an action, you may make the cannon fire a projectile at a creature. Make an attack roll. The cannon deals damage equal to {*}d6 plus the stored energy @force damage. Once you do, the armaments disappear and the spell ends.

If you lose concentration by failing your CON save, or if the battery is taken more than 120ft. away from you, the armaments lose connection and the battery explodes. All creatures in a 10ft. radius around the battery must succeed on a DEX saving throw, taking {*}d6 plus the stored energy @force damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. After that, the cannon will vanish and the spell ends.
What you do with the battery is flexible and up to your creativity, to the DM's discretion. For example:

content.desc: Use an action to mount the battery on a shield. Damage from blocked attacks is absorbed by the battery.
Attach the battery to a weapon handle or to an existing weapon and use it as a weapon. The battery absorbs as much damage as it deals.
Use the battery as half cover.

armaments-of-annihilation.source: Azzurey's Destructive Dictionary of Draconic Discord

augury.name: Augury
vsm: specially marked sticks, bones, or similar tokens worth at least 25 gp

desc.desc: By casting gem-inlaid sticks, rolling dragon bones, laying out ornate cards, or employing some other divining tool, you receive an omen from an otherworldly entity about the results of a specific course of action that you plan to take within the next 30 minutes. The DM chooses from the following possible omens:

content.desc: Weal, for good results
Woe, for bad results
Weal and woe, for both good and bad results
Nothing, for results that are not especially good or bad

desc.desc: The spell does not take into account any possible circumstances that might change the outcome, such as the casting of additional spells or the loss or gain of a companion. If you cast the spell two or more times before completing your next long rest, there is a cumulative 25 percent chance for each casting after the first that you get a random reading. The DM makes this roll in secret.

barkskin.name: Barkskin
vsm: a handful of oak bark

desc.desc: You touch a willing creature. Until the spell ends, the target's skin has a rough, bark-like appearance, and the target's AC can't be less than 16, regardless of what kind of armor it is wearing.
You extend your hand and trace a sigil of warding in the air. Until the end of your next turn, you gain resistance to @bludgeoning, @piercing, and @slashing damage dealt by weapon attacks.

bless.name: Bless
vsm: a sprinkling of holy water

desc.desc: You bless up to {*} creatures of your choice within range. Whenever a target makes an attack roll or a saving throw before the spell ends, the target may roll 1d4 and add the number rolled to the attack roll or saving throw.

Your body becomes blurred, shifting and wavering to all who see you. For the duration, any creature has disadvantage on attack rolls against you. An attacker is immune to this effect if it doesn't rely on sight, as with blindsight, or can see through illusions, as with truesight.

booming-blade.name: Booming Blade
vsm: a melee weapon worth at least 1sp

desc.desc: You brandish the weapon used in the spell's casting. Make a melee attack with it against one creature within 5ft. of you. On a hit, the attack {1}causes the target to become sheathed in booming energy until the start of your next turn. If the target willingly moves 5ft. or more before then, the target takes {2}d8 @thunder damage, and the spell ends.

You attempt to suppress strong emotions in a group of people. Each humanoid in a 20ft. radius sphere centered on a point you choose within range must make a CHA saving throw; a creature can choose to fail this saving throw if it wishes. If a creature fails its saving throw, choose one of the following two effects.

content.desc: You suppress any effect causing a target to be charmed or frightened. When this spell ends, any suppressed effect resumes, provided that its duration has not expired in the meantime.

You make a target indifferent about creatures of your choice that it is hostile toward. This indifference ends if the target is attacked or harmed by a spell or if it witnesses any of its friends being harmed. When the spell ends, the creature becomes hostile again, unless the DM rules otherwise.

desc.desc: Choose one object weighing up to {1}lbs. within range that is not being worn or carried. You may launch the object in a straight line up to 90ft. in a direction you choose before falling to the ground. If the object finds a creature in its path, that creature must succeed on a DEX saving throw, or be struck by the object and take {2}d8 @bludgeoning damage. If the object strikes any creature or other solid surface, it stops moving and takes the same damage as that what it hit.

You attempt to charm a humanoid you can see within range. It must make a WIS saving throw, and does so with advantage if you or your companions are fighting it. If it fails the saving throw, it is charmed by you until the spell ends, or until you or your companions do anything harmful to it. The charmed creature regards you as a friendly acquaintance. When the spell ends, the creature knows it was charmed by you.
You may affect {*} creature(s) with this spell. If you affect multiple, they need to be within 30ft. of each other.

You create a ghostly, skeletal hand in the space of a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the creature to assail it with the chill of the grave. On a hit, the target takes {*}d8 @necrotic damage, and it cannot regain hitpoints until the start of your next turn. Until then, the hand clings to the target. If you hit an undead target, it also gains disadvantage on attack rolls against you until the end of your next turn.

cloud-of-daggers.name: Cloud of Daggers
vsm: a sliver of glass

desc.desc: You fill the air in a 5ft. cube with spinning daggers, centered on a point you choose within range. A creature takes {*}d4 @slashing damage when it enters the spell's area for the first time on a turn, or starts its turn there.

color-spray.name: Color Spray
vsm: a pinch of powder or sand that is colored red, yellow, and blue

desc.desc: A dazzling array of flashing, colored light springs from your hand. This spell blinds all creatures in a 15ft. cone originating from you until the end of your next turn, starting at the creature with the lowest current hitpoints, in ascending order of current hitpoints, up to a maximum of {*}d10 collective hitpoints of all creatures affected (ignoring unconscious creatures and creatures that cannot see).

You speak a one word command to a creature you can see within range. The target must succeed on a WIS saving throw, or follow the command on its next turn. The spell has no effect if the target is undead, if it doesn't understand your language, or if your command is directly harmful to it. If the target cannot follow your command, the spell ends. Some typical commands and their effects:

content.name: Approach
content.desc: The target moves toward you by the shortest and most direct route, ending its turn if it moves within 5ft. of you.

content.name: Drop
content.desc: The target drops whatever it is holding and then ends its turn.

content.name: Flee
content.desc: The target spends its turn moving away from you by the fastest available means.

content.name: Grovel
content.desc: The target falls prone and then ends its turn.

content.name: Halt
content.desc: The target doesn't move and takes no actions. A flying creature stays aloft, provided that it is able to do so. If it must move to stay aloft, it flies the minimum distance needed to remain in the air.

desc.desc: You may affect {*} creature(s) with this spell. If you affect multiple, they need to be within 30ft. of each other.

comprehend-languages.name: Comprehend Languages
vsm: a pinch of soot and salt

desc.desc: For the duration, you understand the literal meaning of any spoken language that you hear. You also understand any written language that you see, but you must be touching the surface on which the words are written. It takes about 1 minute to read one page of text.
his spell does not decode secret messages in a text or glyph, such as an arcane sigil, that is not part of a written language.
You choose nonmagical fire that you can see within range and that fits within a 5ft. cube. You may affect it in one of the following ways:

content.desc: You instantaneously expand the flame 5ft. in one direction, provided that wood or other fuel is present in the new location.
You instantaneously extinguish the flames within the cube.
You double or halve the area of bright light and dim light cast by the flame, change its color, or both. The change lasts for 1 hour.
You cause simple shapes—such as the vague form of a creature, an inanimate object, or a location—to appear within the flames and animate as you like. The shapes last for 1 hour.

desc.desc: If you cast this spell multiple times, you may have up to three of its non-instantaneous effects active at a time, and you may dismiss such an effect as an action.

cordon-of-arrows.name: Cordon of Arrows
vsm: four or more arrows or bolts

desc.desc: You plant {*} pieces of nonmagical ammunition (arrows or crossbow bolts) in the ground within range and lay magic upon them to protect an area. Until the spell ends, whenever a creature other than you comes within 30ft. of the ammunition for the first time on a turn, or ends its turn there, one piece of ammunition flies up to strike it. The creature must succeed on a DEX saving throw or take 1d6 @piercing damage. The piece of ammunition is then destroyed. The spell ends when no ammunition remains.
When you cast this spell, you may designate any creatures you choose, and the spell ignores them.

You create a bonfire on ground that you can see within range. Until the spell ends, the bonfire fills a 5ft. cube. Any creature in the bonfire's space when you cast the spell must succeed on a DEX saving throw or take {*}d8 @fire damage. A creature must also make the saving throw when it enters the bonfire's space for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there.

One humanoid of your choice that you are able to see within range must make a WIS saving throw. On a failure, it becomes charmed by you for the duration. While the target is charmed in this way, a twisted crown of jagged iron appears on its head, and a madness glows in its eyes.

The charmed target must use its action before moving on each of its turns to make a melee attack against a creature other than itself that you mentally choose. The target is able to act normally on its turn if you choose no creature or if none are within its reach.

On your subsequent turns, you must use your action to maintain control over the target, or the spell ends. Also, the target may make a WIS saving throw at the end of each of its turns. On a success, the spell ends.
A creature you touch regains a number of hitpoints equal to {*}d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier. This spell has no effect on undead or constructs.

dancing-lights.name: Dancing Lights
vsm: a bit of phosphorus or wychwood, or a glowworm

desc.desc: You create up to four torch-sized lights within range, making them appear as torches, lanterns, or glowing orbs that hover in the air for the duration, each shedding dim light in a 10ft. radius. You can also combine the four lights into one glowing, vaguely humanoid, form of Medium size.

As a bonus action on your turn, you can move the lights up to 60ft. to a new spot within range. A light must be within 20ft. of another light created by this spell, and a light winks out if it exceeds the spell's range.

darkness.name: Darkness
vsm: bat fur, and a drop of pitch, or piece of coal

desc.desc: Magical darkness spreads from a point you choose within range to fill a 15ft. radius sphere. The darkness spreads around corners. A creature with darkvision cannot see through this darkness, and nonmagical light cannot illuminate it.

If the point you choose is on an object you are holding, or one that isn't being worn or carried, the darkness emanates from the object and moves with it. Completely covering the source of the darkness with an opaque object, such as a bowl or a helm, blocks the darkness.
If any of this spell's area overlaps with an area of light created by a spell of 2nd level or lower, the spell that created the light is dispelled.

dive-of-desolation.name: Dive of Desolation
vsm: a cicada

desc.desc: You channel your soul, briefly hover mid-air and wrap yourself in a blinding light. Losing all forward momentum, you drop straight down and accelerate your fall to dangerous speeds, landing within seconds.

Upon landing, you negate the fall damage you would've taken; the white light roars outward, sending out a shockwave, audible within 300ft. Any creature within 10ft. of your landing point needs to succeed on a DEX saving throw, taking {*}d8 @force damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.

dive-of-desolation.source: Azzurey's Destructive Dictionary of Draconic Discord

desc.desc: Your prayer empowers you with divine radiance. For the duration, your weapon attacks deal an extra 1d4 @radiant damage on hit.
Whispering to the spirits of nature, you create one of the following effects within range:

content.desc: For one round, you create a tiny, harmless sensory effect that predicts what the weather will be at your location for the next 24 hours. The effect might manifest as a golden orb for clear skies, a cloud for rain, falling snowflakes for snow, and so on.
You instantly make a flower blossom, a seed pod open, or a leaf bud bloom.
You create an instantaneous, harmless sensory effect, such as falling leaves, a puff of wind, the sound of a small animal, or the faint odor of skunk, that must fit within a 5ft. cube.
You instantly light or snuff out a candle, a torch, or a small campfire.

desc.desc: You cause a tremor in the ground in a 10ft radius. Each creature other than you in that area must succeed on a DEX saving throw, or take {*}d6 @bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone. If the ground in that area is loose earth or stone, it becomes difficult terrain until cleared.
A beam of crackling energy streaks towards a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 1d10 @force damage.
This spell creates {*} beam(s) of energy. Should there be multiple, make a seperate attack roll for each one.

enlarge-reduce.name: Enlarge/Reduce
vsm: a pinch of powdered iron

desc.desc: You cause a creature or an object you can see within range to grow larger or smaller for the duration. Choose either a creature or an object that is neither worn nor carried. If the target is unwilling, it may make a CON saving throw. On a success, the spell has no effect.
If the target is a creature, everything it is wearing and carrying changes size with it. Any item dropped by an affected creature returns to normal size at once.

content.name: Enlarge
content.desc: The target's size doubles in all dimensions, and its weight is multiplied by eight. This growth increases its size by one category (from Medium to Large, for example). If there is not enough room for the target to double its size, the creature or object attains the maximum possible size in the space available. Until the spell ends, the target also has advantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws. The target's weapons also grow to match its new size, dealing 1d4 extra damage.

content.name: Reduce
content.desc: The target's size is halved in all dimensions, and its weight is reduced to one-eighth of normal. This reduction decreases its size by one category (from Medium to Small, for example). Until the spell ends, the target also has disadvantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws. Likewise, the target's weapons also shrink to match its new size, deal 1d4 less damage (this cannot reduce the damage below 1).

desc.desc: You hurl a mote of fire at a creature or object within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes {*}d10 @fire damage. A flammable object hit by this spell ignites if it isn't being worn or carried.

fire-shield.name: Fire Shield
vsm: a bit of phosphorus, or a firefly

desc.desc: Thin and wispy flames wreathe your body for the duration, shedding bright light in a 10ft. radius, and dim light in another 10ft. You can end the spell early by using an action to dismiss it.
The flames provide you with a warm shield or a chill shield, as you choose. The warm shield gives you resistance to @cold damage, and the chill shield grants your resistance to @fire damage.

Additionally, whenever a creature within 5ft. of you hits you with a melee attack, the shield erupts with flame. The attacker takes 2d8 @fire damage from a warm shield, or 2d8 @cold damage from a chill shield.

fireball.name: Fireball
vsm: a tiny ball of bat guano and sulfur

desc.desc: A bright streak flashes from your pointing finger to a point you choose within range, then blossoms with a low roar into an explosion of flame. Each creature in a 20ft. radius must make a DEX saving throw, taking {*}d6 @fire damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. The fire spreads around corners, and ignites flammable objects in the area that aren't being worn or carried.

You create a {*}ft. radius sphere of fog centered on a point within range. The sphere spreads around corners, and its area is heavily obscured. It lasts for the duration or until a wind of moderate or greater speed (at least 10 mi/h) disperses it.

friends.name: Friends
vsm: a small amount of makeup applied to your face

desc.desc: For the duration, you gain advantage on all CHA checks directed at a creature of your choice that is not hostile toward you.

When the spell ends, the creature realizes that you used magic to influence its mood and may become hostile toward you. A creature prone to violence may attack you. Another creature may seek retribution in other ways (at the DM's discretion), depending on the nature of your interaction with it.

You cause numbing frost to form on a creature that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a CON saving throw, or take {*}d6 @cold damage and gain disadvantage on the next weapon attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn.
You touch a willing creature. For the duration, the target may add 1d8 to its initiative rolls.

goodberry.name: Goodberry
vsm: a sprig of mistletoe

desc.desc: Up to ten magically infused berries appear in your hand. A creature may use its action to eat one berry, which restores 1 hitpoint, and the berry provides enough nourishment to sustain a creature for one day.
The berries lose their potency if they have not been consumed within 24 hours of the casting of this spell.

green-flame-blade.name: Green-Flame Blade
vsm: a melee weapon worth at least 1sp

desc.desc: You brandish the weapon used in the spell's casting and make a melee attack with it against one creature within 5 feet of you. On a hit,{1} you may cause green fire to leap from the target to a different creature of your choice that you can see within 5ft. of the target, dealing {2} @fire damage to it.

levels: the target takes an additional 1d8 @fire damage, and
the target takes an additional 2d8 @fire damage, and
the target takes an additional 3d8 @fire damage, and

desc.desc: You touch 1 willing creature. Once before the spell ends, the target may roll 1d4, and add the number rolled to one ability check of its choice. It may roll this die before or after making the ability check. The spell then ends.

A flash of light streaks toward a creature of your choice within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes {*}d6 @radiant damage, and they are covered in a dim, mystical glittering light. The next attack roll made against this target before the end of your next turn has advantage.
You seize the air and compel it to create one of the following effects at a point you can see within range:

content.desc: One Medium or smaller creature that you choose must succeed on a STR saving throw or be pushed up to 5ft. away from you.

You create a small blast of air capable of moving one object that is neither held nor carried and that weighs no more than 5lbs. The object is pushed up to 10ft. away from you. It isn't pushed with enough force to cause damage.
You create a harmless sensory affect using air, such as causing leaves to rustle, wind to slam shutters shut, or your clothing to ripple in a breeze.

desc.desc: A creature of your choice that you can see within range regains hitpoints equal to {*}d4 + your spellcasting ability modifier. This spell has no effect on undead or constructs.

castTime.condition: you are damaged by a creature within 60ft. of you that you can see

desc.desc: You point your finger, and the creature that damaged you is momentarily surrounded by hellish flames. The creature must make a DEX saving throw, taking {*}d10 @fire damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.

A willing creature you touch is imbued with bravery. For the duration, the creature is immune to being frightened, and gains temporary hitpoints equal to your spellcasting ability modifier at the start of each of its turns. When the spell ends, the target loses any remaining temporary hitpoints from this spell.
You may affect {*} creature(s) with this spell.

A creature of your choice that you can see within range perceives everything as hilariously funny and falls into fits of laughter if this spell affects it. The target must succeed on a WIS saving throw or fall prone, becoming incapacitated and unable to stand up for the duration. A creature with an INT score of 4 or less isn't affected.

At the end of each of its turns, and each time it takes damage, the target can make another WIS saving throw. The target has advantage on the saving throw if it's triggered by damage. On a success, the spell ends.

hold-person.name: Hold Person
vsm: a small, straight piece of iron

desc.desc: Choose a humanoid that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a WIS saving throw or be paralyzed for the duration. At the end of each of its turns, the target can make another WIS saving throw. On a success, the spell ends on the target.
You may affect {*} humanoid(s) with this spell. If you affect multiple, they need to be within 30ft. of each other.

hypnotic-pattern.name: Hypnotic Pattern
vsm: a glowing stick of incense or a crystal vial filled with phosphorescent material

desc.desc: You create a twisting pattern of colors that weaves through the air inside a 30ft. cube within range. The pattern appears for a moment and vanishes. Each creature in the area who sees the pattern must make a WIS saving throw. On a failed save, the creature becomes charmed for the duration. While charmed by this spell, the creature is incapacitated and has a speed of 0.
The spell ends for an affected creature if it takes any damage or if someone else uses an action to shake the creature out of its stupor.

infestation.name: Infestation
vsm: a living flea

desc.desc: You cause a cloud of mites, fleas, and other parasites to appear momentarily on one creature you can see within range. The target must succeed on a CON saving throw or take {*}d6 @poison damage and move 5ft. in a random direction if it is able to move and its speed is at least 5ft. This movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks, and if the direction rolled is blocked, the target doesn't move. Roll 1d4 for the direction:
You touch a creature and may end either one disease or one condition afflicting it. The condition may be blinded, deafened, paralyzed, or poisoned.

You create a lash of lightning energy that strikes at one creature of your choice that you can see within 15ft. of you. The target must succeed on a STR saving throw or be pulled up to 10ft. in a straight line toward you and then take {*}d8 @lightning damage if it is within 5ft. of you.

A spectral, floating hand appears at a point you choose within range. The hand lasts for the duration, or until you dismiss it as an action. The hand vanishes if it is ever more than 30ft. away from you, or if you cast this spell again.

You may use your action to control this hand. You may use the hand to manipulate an object, open an unlocked door or container, stow or retrieve an item from an open container, or pour the contents out of a vial. You may move the hand up to 30ft. each time you use it.
The hand cannot attack, activate magical items, or carry more than 10 lbs.

You create {*} glowing darts of magical force. Each dart hits a creature of your choice that you can see within range. A dart deals 1d4 + 1 @force damage to its target. The darts all strike simultaneously and you can direct them to hit one creature or several.

You touch 1 to 3 pebbles and imbue them with magic. You or someone else may make a ranged spell attack with one of the pebbles by throwing it, or hurling it with a sling. If thrown, it has a range of 60ft. If someone else attacks with the pebble, that attacker adds your spellcasting ability modifier (not the attacker's) to the attack roll. On a hit, the target takes 1d6 + your spellcasting ability modifier @bludgeoning damage. Hit or miss, the spell then ends on the stone.
If you cast this spell again, the spell ends early on any pebbles still affected by it.

As you call out words of restoration, up to six creatures of your choice that you can see within range regain HP equal to {*}d4 + your spellcasting ability modifier. This spell has no effect on undead or constructs.

mending.name: Mending
vsm: two lodestones

desc.desc: This spell repairs a single break or tear that is no longer than 1ft. in any dimension in an object you touch, such as a broken chain link, two halves of a broken key, a torn cloak, or a leaking wineskin.
This spell can physically repair a magic item or construct, but cannot restore magic to such an object.

minor-illusion.name: Minor Illusion
vsm: a bit of fleece

desc.desc: You create a sound or an image of an object within range that lasts for the duration. The illusion also ends if you dismiss it as an action, or cast this spell again.

If you create a sound, its volume can range from a whisper to a scream. It can be your voice, someone else's voice, a lion's roar, a beating of drums, or any other sound you choose. The sound continues unabated through the duration, or you can make discrete sounds at different times before the spell ends.

If you create an image of an object, such as a chair, muddy footprints, or a small chest, it must be no larger than a 5ft. cube. The image can't create sound, light, smell, or any other sensory effect. Physical interaction with the image reveals it to be an illusion, because things can pass through it.

If a creature uses its action to examine the sound or image, the creature can determine that it is an illusion with a successful Investigation (INT) check, against your spell save DC. If a creature discerns the illusion for what it is, the illusion becomes faint to the creature.

Three illusory duplicates of yourself appear in your space. Until the spell ends, the duplicates move with you and mimic your actions, shifting position so it's impossible to track which image is real. You can use your action to dismiss the illusory duplicates.
Each time a creature targets you with an attack during the spell's duration, roll a d20 to determine whether the attack instead targets one of your duplicates.

If you have three duplicates, you must roll a 6 or higher to change the attack's target to a duplicate. With two duplicates, you must roll an 8 or higher. With one duplicate, you must roll an 11 or higher.

A duplicate's AC equals 10 + your DEX modifier. If an attack hits a duplicate, the duplicate is destroyed. A duplicate can be destroyed only by an attack that hits it. It ignores all other damage and effects. The spell ends when all three duplicates are destroyed.
A creature is unaffected by this spell if it can't see, if it relies on senses other than sight, such as blindsight, or if it can perceive illusions as false, as with truesight.
You choose a portion of dirt or stone that you can see within range and that fits within a 5ft. cube. You manipulate it in one of the following ways:

content.desc: If you target an area of loose earth, you may instantaneously excavate it, move it along the ground, and deposit it up to 5ft. away. This movement doesn't have enough force to cause damage.
You cause shapes, colors, or both to appear on the dirt or stone, spelling out words, creating images, or shaping patterns. The changes last for 1 hour.

If the dirt or stone you target is on the ground, you cause it to become difficult terrain. Alternatively, you may cause the ground to become normal terrain if it is already difficult terrain. This change lasts for 1 hour.

desc.desc: If you cast this spell multiple times, you can have no more than two of its non-instantaneous effects active at a time, and you may dismiss such an effect as an action.
You tap into the nightmares of a creature you can see within range and create an illusory manifestation of its deepest fears, visible only to that creature

The target must make a WIS saving throw. On a failed save, the target becomes frightened of you for the duration. At the end of each of the target's turns before the spell ends, the target must succeed on a WIS saving throw or take {*}d10 @psychic damage. On a successful save, the spell ends.
You extend your hand toward a creature you can see within range and project a puff of noxious gas from your palm. The creature must succeed on a CON saving throw or take {*}d12 poison damage.

power-fist.name: Power Fist
vsm: a severed finger

desc.desc: You concentrate artificial power into your melee weapon. Make a melee weapon attack. On a hit, your attack will critically strike and knock the target prone.

protection-from-evil-and-good.name: Protection from Evil and Good
vsm: holy water, or powdered silver and iron, which the spell consumes

desc.desc: For the duration, one willing creature you touch is protected against the following types of creatures: aberrations, celestials, elementals, fey, fiends, and undead. The protection grants the following benefits:

content.desc: The listed creatures gain disadvantage on attack rolls against the protected creature.
The protected creature cannot be charmed, frightened, or possessed by the listed creatures.
If the protected creature is already charmed, frightened, or possessed by one of the listed creatures, the protected creature gainst advantage on any future saving throw against the relevant effect.

desc.desc: A frigid beam of blue-white light streaks towards a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, it takes {*}d8 @cold damage, and its speed is reduced by 10ft. until the start of your next turn.

A ray of sickening greenish energy lashes out toward a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes {*}d8 @poison damage and must succeed on a CON saving throw, or is also poisoned until the end of your next turn.

Flame-like radiance descends on a creature that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a DEX saving throw or take {*}d8 @radiant damage. The target gains no benefit from cover for this saving throw.

sanctuary.name: Sanctuary
vsm: a small silver mirror

desc.desc: You ward a creature within range against attack. For the duration, any creature who targets the warded creature with an attack or harmful spell must succeed on a WIS saving throw, or choose a new target or lose the attack or spell. This spell does not protect the warded creature from area effects, such as the explosion of a fireball.
If the warded creature makes an attack, casts a spell that affects an unwilling creature, or deals damage to another creature, the spell ends.

sending.name: Sending
vsm: a short piece of fine copper wire

desc.desc: You send a short message of 25 words or less to a creature with which you are familiar. The creature hears the message in its mind, recognizes you as the sender if it knows you, and can answer in a like manner immediately. The spell enables creatures with INT scores of at least 1 to understand the meaning of your message.
You can send the message across any distance and even to other planes of existence, but if the target is on a different plane than you, there is a 5 percent chance that the message doesn't arrive.
You choose an area of water that you can see within range and that fits within a 5ft. cube. You manipulate it in one of the following ways:

content.desc: You instantaneously move or otherwise change the flow of the water as you direct, up to 5ft. in any direction. This movement doesn't have enough force to cause damage.
You cause the water to form into simple shapes and animate at your instruction. This change lasts for 1 hour.
You change the water's color or opacity. The water must be changed in the same way throughout. This change lasts for 1 hour.
You freeze the water, provided that there are no creatures in it. The water unfreezes in 1 hour.

shatter.name: Shatter
vsm: a chip of mica

desc.desc: A sudden loud ringing noise, painfully intense, erupts from a point of your choice within range. Each creature in a 10ft. radius sphere centered on that point must make a CON saving throw. A creature takes {*}d8 @thunder damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature made of inorganic material such as stone, crystal, or metal has disadvantage on this saving throw.
A nonmagical object that isn't being worn or carried also takes the damage if it's in the spell's area.

shield-of-faith.name: Shield of Faith
vsm: a small parchment with a bit of holy text written on it

desc.desc: A shimmering field appears and surrounds a creature of your choice within range, granting it +2 AC for the duration.

For the duration, no sound is able to be created within or pass through a 20ft. sphere centered on a point you choose within range. Any creature or object entirely inside the sphere is immune to @thunder damage, and creatures are deafened while entirely inside it. Casting a spell that includes a verbal component is impossible there.

silent-image.name: Silent Image
vsm: a bit of fleece

desc.desc: You create the image of an object, a creature or some other visible phenomenon that is no larger than a 15ft. cube. The image appears at a spot within range, and lasts for the duration. The image is purely visual: it is not accompanied by sound, smell or other sensory effects.

You may use your action to cause the image to move to any spot within range. As the image changes location, you may alter its appearance so that its movements appear natural for the image. For example, if you create an image of a creature and move it, you may alter the image so that it appears to be walking.

Physical interaction with the image reveals it to be an illusion, because things can pass through it. A creature that uses its action to examine the image can determine that it is an illusion with a successful Investigation (INT) check against your spell save DC. If a creature discerns the illusion for what it is, the creature can see through the image.

sleep.name: Sleep
vsm: a pinch of fine sand, rose petals, or a cricket

desc.desc: This spell sends creatures into a magical slumber. Roll {*}d8. The total is how many hitpoints of creatures this spell can affect. Creatures within 20ft. of a point you choose within range are affected in ascending order of their current hitpoints, ignoring unconscious creatures. Subtract each creature's hitpoints from the total before moving on to the creature with the next lowest hitpoints. A creature's hitpoints must be equal to or less than the remaining total for that creature to be affected. Undead and creatures immune to being charmed aren't affected by this spell.

Starting with the creature that has the lowest current hitpoints, each creature affected by the spell falls unconscious until the spell ends, the sleeper takes damage, or someone uses an action to wake the sleeper.

spaciodisplacement.name: Spaciodisplacement

desc.desc: You shift all of existence, except one creature, slightly into a direction of choice, causing the target to appear to blink 5ft. This creature takes {*}d4 @psychic damage.

The shift can be into any direction, but the target cannot be shifted into a solid object. If the target is shifted into the space of another creature, both the target and that creature take an additional {*}d4 @force damage. The target is then shunted out to the nearest unoccupied space again.

spaciodisplacement.source: Azzurey's Destructive Dictionary of Draconic Discord

desc.desc: You manifest a minor wonder - a sign of supernatural power - within range. Create one of the following effects:

content.desc: Your voice booms up to three times as loud as normal.
You cause flames to flicker, brighten, dim, or change color.
You cause harmless tremors in the ground.
You create an instantaneous sound that originates from a point of your choice within range, such as a rumble of thunder, the cry of a raven, or ominous whispers.
You instantaneously cause an unlocked door or window to fly open or shut.
You alter the apearance of your eyes.

desc.desc: If you cast this spell multiple times, you may have up to 3 of its non-instantaneous effects active at a time, and you may dismiss such an effect as an action.
You create a burst of thunderous sound, which can be heard 100ft. away. Each creature other than you within 5ft. of you must succeed on a CON saving throw or take {*}d6 @thunder damage.

You point at one creature you can see within range, and the sound of a dolorous bell fills the air around it for a moment. The target must succeed on a WIS saving throw, or take {*}d8 @necrotic damage. If the target is missing any of its hitpoints, it takes {*}d12 @necrotic damage instead.

true-silence.name: True Silence
vsm: a hollow crystal orb containing a vacuum

desc.desc: With a gentle shush, silence falls at your whim.

For the duration, a 40ft. radius sphere centered on a point within range falls completely silent; not only sound waves cannot exist within this space, the air goes completely still, as the air's very atoms fall silent and stop in their tracks. Creatures and objects completely inside the sphere are immune to @thunder damage, and creatures completely inside the sphere are deafened.

A creature starting its turn inside the sphere, or entering the sphere for the first time must succeed on a DEX saving throw, or fall into stasis, becoming paralyzed and falling unconscious for the duration. On a success, the creature retains consciousness, but its speed is reduced to 5ft. A creature in stasis by this spell takes 4d12 @cold damage when it fails the saving throw, and at the start of each of its turns afterwards; a creature succeeding the save takes half the damage.

Melee attacks inside or into the sphere are impossible, and casting a spell that includes a verbal component is impossible while inside the sphere. Ranged weapon or spell attacks, as well as any other spell effect that passes through the sphere are halted and suspended in the absolute zero. These attacks and effects have their effects delayed until the spell ends.

true-silence.source: Azzurey's Destructive Dictionary of Draconic Discord

undo.name: Undo

desc.desc: You magically rewind yourself to a previous position. You blink to the space you were in 6 seconds. In combat, you blink to the space you were in at the start of your previous turn.

levels: You may also cast this cantrip as a reaction, which you take when you are subjected to a DEX saving throw to avoid an effect, taking half the damage on a failed save, and no damage on a successful one.

You may also cast this cantrip as a reaction, which you take when you are subjected to a DEX saving throw to avoid an effect, taking half the damage on a failed save, and no damage on a successful one.
undo.source: Azzurey's Destructive Dictionary of Draconic Discord

unseen-servant.name: Unseen Servant
vsm: a piece of string and a bit of wood

desc.desc: This spell creates an invisible, mindless, shapeless, Medium-size force that performs simple tasks at your command until the spell ends. The servant springs into existence in an unoccupied space on the ground within range. It has AC 10, 1 hitpoint, a STR score of 2, and it cannot attack. If it drops to 0 hitpoints, the spell ends.

Once on each of your turns as a bonus action, you may mentally command the servant to move up to 15ft. and interact with an object. The servant is able to perform simple tasks that a human servant could do, such as fetching things, cleaning, mending, folding clothes, lighting fires, serving food, and pouring wine. Once you give the command, the servant performs the task to the best of its ability until it completes the task, then waits for your next command.
If you command the servant to perform a task that would move it more than 60ft. away from you, the spell ends.

You unleash a string of insults laced with subtle enchantments at a creature you can see within range. If the target is able to hear you (though it need not understand you), it must succeed on a WIS saving throw or take {*}d4 @psychic damage, and gain disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn.

wall-of-fire.name: Wall of Fire
vsm: a small piece of phosphorus

desc.desc: You create a wall of fire on a solid surface within range. You can make the wall up to 60ft. long, 20ft. high and 1ft. thick, or a ringed wall up to 20ft. in diameter, 20ft. high and 1ft. thick. The wall is opaque and lasts for the duration.
When the wall appears, each creature in its area must make a DEX saving throw, taking {*}d8 @fire damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.

One side of the wall, selected by you when you cast, deals {*}d8 @fire damage to each creature that ends its turn within 10ft. of that side of the wall, or inside the wall. A creature takes the same damage when it enters the wall for the first time on a turn, or ends its turn there. The other side of the wall deals no damage.
A strong wind (20 miles per hour) blows around you in a 10ft. radius and moves with you, remaining centered on you. The wind lasts for the spell's duration.
The wind has the following effects:

content.desc: It deafens you and other creatures in its area.
It extinguishes unprotected flames in its area that are torch-sized or smaller.
The area is difficult terrain for creatures other than you.
The attack rolls of ranged weapon attacks have disadvantage if they pass in or out of the wind.
It hedges out vapor, gas, and fog that can be dispersed by strong wind.

witch-bolt.name: Witch Bolt
vsm: a twig from a tree that has been struck by lightning

desc.desc: A beam of crackling, blue energy lances out toward a creature within range, forming a sustained arc of lightning between you and the target. Make a ranged spell attack against that creature. On a hit, the target takes {*}d12 @lightning damage, and for the duration, at the end of each of your turns, you may use your action to deal 1d12 @lightning damage to the target automatically. The spell ends if you use your action to do anything else, if the target is ever outside the spell's range, or if the target has total cover from you.

The next time you hit with a melee weapon attack during the duration, your attack deals an extra 1d6 @psychic damage. Additionally, if the target is a creature, it must make a WIS saving throw or be frightened of you until the spell ends. As an action, the creature may make a Wisdom check against your spell save DC to steel its resolve and end this spell.
You move like the wind. For the duration, your movement does not provoke opportunity attacks.

Once before the spell ends, you can give yourself advantage on one weapon attack roll on your turn. That attack deals an extra 1d8 @force damage on a hit. Whether you hit or miss, your walking speed increases by 30ft. until the end of that turn.

You create a magical zone that guards against deception in a 15ft. radius sphere centered on a point of your choice within range. For the duration, a creature that enters the spell's area for the first time on a turn, or starts its turn there, must succeed on a CHA saving throw, or cannot speak a deliberate lie while in the radius. You know whether each creature succeeds or fails on its saving throw.

An affected creature is aware of the spell and can thus avoid answering questions to which it would normally respond with a lie. Such creatures can be evasive in its answers as long as it remains within the boundaries of the truth.

You extend your hand and point a finger at a target in range. Your magic grants you a brief insight into the target's defenses. On your next turn, you gain advantage on your first attack roll against the target, provided that this spell hasn't ended.

You drive a disorienting spike of psychic energy into the mind of a creature you can see within range. The target must succeed on an INT saving throw or take {*}d6 @psychic damage, and subtract 1d4 from the next saving throw it makes before the end of your next turn.
You create a minor magical trick within range that novice spellcasters use for practice. Choose one of the following magical effects:

content.desc: You create an instantaneous, harmless sensory effect, such as a shower of sparks, a puff of wind, faint musical notes, or an odd odor.
You instantaneously light or snuff out a candle, a torch, or a small campfire.
You instantaneously clear or soil an object no larger than 1cu.ft.
You chill, warm or flavor up to 1cu.ft. of nonliving material for 1 hour.
You make a color, small mark or symbol appear on an object or surface for 1 hour.
You create a nonmagical trinket or illusory image that is able to fit your hand. It lasts until the end of your next turn.

desc.desc: You create a momentary circle of spectral blades that sweep around you. All other creatures within 5ft. of you must succeed on a DEX saving throw, or take {*}d6 @force damage.

You attempt to compel a creature into a duel. A creature that you can see within range must succeed a WIS saving throw, or be drawn to you, compelled by your divine demand. For the duration, it gains disadvantage on attack rolls against creatures other than you, and must succeed on a WIS saving throw each time it attempts to move to a space that is more than 30ft. away from you. On a success, this spell does not restrict the target's movement for that turn.

The spell ends if you attack a creature other than the target, cast a spell that targets a hostile creature other than the target, if a creature hostile to it damages the target or casts a harmful spell on it, or if you end your turn more than 30ft. away from the target.

You hurl a twisting bolt of blood at a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes {*}d6 @necrotic damage, and you gain a number of temporary hitpoints equal to your proficiency bonus.

hex.name: Hex
vsm: the petrified eye of a newt

desc.desc: You place a curse on a creature that you can see within range. For the duration, you deal an extra 1d6 @necrotic damage to the target whenever you hit it with an attack. Also, choose an ability when you cast the spell. The target has disadvantage on ability checks made with the chosen ability.
If the target drops to 0 hitpoints before this spell ends, as a bonus action on subsequent turns, you may curse a new creature.

You summon a random sea creature at a target you can see within range. Roll 1d4 to determine what sea creature you summon, then make a ranged spell attack. If you miss, or the effects ends, the sea creature is transported back to the waters it came from with an audible splash.

content: A tuna flies in from an inexplicable direction, hitting the target in the head. The target takes 1d4 @cold damage and 1d4 @bludgeoning damage.
An electric eel drops onto the target and clings around its neck. The target takes 1d8 @lightning damage.

Crabs burrow from under the ground and cling onto the targets skin, continuously pinching it. The target takes 1d4 @piercing damage on the start of each of its turns for 1 minute. As an action, an affected creature may remove the crab, ending the effect on itself.
The octopus attempts to cling onto the target's face. The target takes 1d4 @poison damage and must succeed on a STR saving throw, or be blinded until the end of its next turn.

desc.desc: This spell summons {*} sea creature(s). Should there be multiple, roll 1d4 and make a seperate attack roll for each one.

You invoke the wisdom of your ancestors to gain insight into your trials. When you cast the spell, and at the start of each of your turns for the duration, you gain inspiration if you don't already have it.

blood-sacrifice.name: Blood Sacrifice
vsm: a drop of your own blood

desc.desc: You sacrifice a portion of your lifeforce to enhance your magical power. When you cast this spell, you take {*}d6 @necrotic damage, which cannot be reduced or prevented in any way. For the duration, whenever you cast a spell that deals damage, one target of the spell of your choice takes an extra {*}d6 damage of the spell's normal damage type (your choice if there are multiple).

buried-alive.name: Buried Alive
vsm: a pinch of grave dirt

desc.desc: You send your enemies to their graves, even if they aren't dead yet. Choose a creature within range that you can see. The target must make a STR saving throw. On a failure, the ground opens and swallows the target, burying it up to 10ft. deep. On a success, the target is instead knocked prone, and its speed is reduced to 0 until the end of its next turn.

While buried, the target has total cover, is restrained and blinded, and cannot breathe. A buried creature may use its action to dig out of the grave if it succeeds on a DC 15 Athletics (STR) check. On a success, it digs 5ft. closer to the surface. If it succeeds by 5 or more, it reaches the surface. When it does, it exits the ground prone.
The target automatically succeeds on its saving throw if it's standing on any thickness of stone or metal, or at least 2in. of wood.

call-of-the-wild.name: Call of the Wild
vsm: a bit of animal fur or hide

desc.desc: You unleash a primal howl that calls lesser creatures to your command. When you cast the spell, each Beast in a 50ft. radius sphere centered on you must make a WIS saving throw. On a failure, the target is charmed by you, it is able to understand your commands, and it follows them on its turn to the best of its abilities. For the duration, as an action, you may issue new commands. On a success, the target is charmed by you until the start of your next turn, but you gain no additional ability to command it.
The howl is audible to anyone within 300ft. of you.

captivate-undead.name: Captivate Undead
vsm: a pinch of bone dust

desc.desc: You usurp the negative energy animating {*} Undead creature(s) that you can see within range, attempting to take control. The target must make a CHA saving throw. On a failure, for the duration, the target is charmed by you while ignoring immunity to being charmed, and it becomes friendly toward you. On a success, the target gains disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes against you before the start of your next turn. If you, or any of your allies, deal damage to the target, or force it to make a saving throw, the spell ends early.

You hurl a spectral, barbed chain at a creature you can see within range. The target must make a STR saving throw, taking {*}d6 @force damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. Additionally, on a failure, the target is pulled up to 30ft. toward you, and becomes bound by the chain. While bound, the creature is tethered to you, cannot move or teleport to a space more than 30ft. away from you, and you gain advantage on attack rolls against it.

A bound creature may repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If you ever move more than 30ft. away from the bound creature, the spell ends early.

chorus-of-the-lost.name: Chorus of the Lost
vsm: a silver bell worth at least 10gp

desc.desc: You summon the eerie song and wailing of lost souls from a point you can see within range. Each creature in a 15ft. radius sphere centered on that point must make a WIS saving throw, taking {*}d6 @psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. Additionally, on a failure, the target becomes frightened of you for the duration. On a success, it instead becomes frightened of you until the end of its next turn.
A frightened target may repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turn, ending the effect on itself on a success.

You cause a creature that you can see within range to burst into consuming, relentless flames. The target must make a DEX saving throw, taking 2d8 @fire damage and either 2d8 @necrotic or @radiant damage, your choice, on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.

Additionally, on a failure, the flames linger. While they do, the target takes the damage again at the start of each of its turns. The target, or another creature within reach of it, may use its action to allow the target to repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success.
A creature killed by the damage from this spell is reduced to ash, along with any nonmagical equipment it was wearing or carrying.

You send tendrils of black and gray rot toward a target that you can see within range. Tendrils then leap from that target to up to {*} other targets within 30ft. of it. A target may be a creature, or a nonmagical plant that is not a creature, such as a tree or shrub. A target may be targeted by one tendril each.

A creature hit by a tendril must succeed on a CON saving throw, or take 3d8 @necrotic damage and be poisoned for the duration. A creature poisoned in this way takes 1d8 @necrotic damage at the start of each of its turns. A poisoned creature may repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
A Plant creature automatically fails the saving throw from this spell. Nonmagical plants that are hit simply wither and die.

crimson-harvest.name: Crimson Harvest
vsm: a vial of blood

desc.desc: A wave of blood sweeps out from you. Each creature of your choice within 15ft. of you that is not behind total cover must make a DEX saving throw, taking {*}d10 @necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.
If you damage at least one Small or larger creature with this spell, a creature of your choice that you can see within the area regains a number of hitpoints equal to half the damage roll.

crooked-ward.name: Crooked Ward
vsm: a five-pointed wicker star

desc.desc: You touch an immobile surface and mark a symbol that causes agony in twisted creatures. An invisible, 30ft. radius sphere springs out from the point you touch. Every aberration, fey, fiend, monstrosity, or undead in the sphere gains disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls. Whenever an affected creature enters the sphere for the the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it must succeed on a WIS saving throw or be frightened of you until the start of its next turn.

A storm cloud, shaped like a 10ft. tall, 60ft. radius cylinder, appears centered on a point you can see within range directly above you. If you cannot see a point in the air where the storm cloud could appear (eg. you are in a room that cannot accomodate the cloud), the spell fails.

When you cast the spell, choose a point you can see under the cloud. A bolt of lightning flashes down from the cloud to that point. Each creature within 5ft. of that point must make a DEX saving throw, taking {*}d10 @lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. On each of your turns until the spell ends, you may use your action to call down lightning in this way again, targeting any point underneath the cloud.

If you are outdoors in stormy conditions when you cast this spell, the spell gives you control over the existing storm instead of creating a new one. Under such conditions, the spell's damage increases by 1d10.

You hurl an undulating, warbling mass of chaotic energy at a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 2d8 + {*}d6 damage. Choose one of the d8s. The number rolled on that die determines the attack's damage type, as shown below.

If you roll the same number on both d8s, the chaotic energy leaps from the target to a different creature of your choice within 30ft. of it. Make a new attack roll against the new target, and make a new damage roll, which could cause the chaotic energy to leap again. However, a creature may be targeted only once by each casting of this spell.

identify.name: Identify
vsm: a pearl worth at least 100gp, and an owl feather

desc.desc: You choose an object that you must touch throughout the casting of the spell. If it is a magic item or some other magic-imbued object, you learn its properties and how to use them, whether it requires attunement to use, and how many charges it has, if any. You learn whether any spells are affecting the item and what they are. If the item was created by a spell, you learn which spell created it. Alternatively, if you touch a creature throughout the casting, you learn what spells, if any, are currently affecting it.

You choose a creature you can see within range and mystically mark it as your quarry. Until the spell ends, you deal an extra 1d6 damage to the target whenever you hit it with a weapon attack, and you gain advantage on any Perception (WIS) or Survival (WIS) check you make to find it. If the target drops to 0 hitpoints before this spell ends, as a bonus action, you may mark a new creature.

frost-fingers.name: Frost Fingers

desc.desc: Freezing cold blasts from your fingertips in a 15ft. cone. Each creature in that area must make a CON saving throw, taking {*}d8 @cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The cold freezes nonmagical liquids in the area that aren't being worn or carried.

frost-fingers.source: Icewind Dale - Rime of the Frostmaiden

desc.desc: You create a ghostly sickle that lasts for the duration, and may strike out at your foes. The sickle appears hovering in your space, and moves with you. Whenever you cast this spell, and as a bonus action on each of your turns, you may direct it to fly at and strike a creature within 30ft. of you. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target takes {*}d8 @necrotic damage, and you gain temporary hitpoints equal to half the damage dealt. After the sickle hits or misses, it returns to hover in your space.

cursed-cacophony.name: Cursed Cacophony
vsm: a sheet of music

desc.desc: You focus on a creature that you are familiar with that is on the same plane of existance as you. The target must succeed on a WIS saving throw, or be cursed for the duration. Once a target fails its saving throw against this spell, you cannot target it with a ritual casting of the spell for 24 hours.

While cursed, the target hears haunting, discordant music, and gains disadvantage on ability checks, attack rolls, and saving throws. The first time the target fails one of these rolls during a turn, it may repeat the saving throw with neither advantage or disadvantage, ending the effect early on itself on a success.

devils-due.name: Devil's Due

castTime.condition: another creature within range takes damage

vsm: a glob of pitch

desc.desc: You absorb a measure of a creature's suffering and escaping vital essence. Expend and roll {*} Hit Di(c)e. You regain a number of hitpoints equal to the number rolled + your spellcasting modifier.
If the creature took damage from a critical hit, you regain twice the amount of hitpoints.

You touch a creature, or nonmagical object, and break the target's substance down into its most fundamental components. Make a melee spell attack. On a hit, the target takes {*}d8 @force damage, and it suffers -1 AC against the next attack roll made against it before the end of your next turn.

eye-burn.name: Eye Burn

castTime.condition: a creature you can see within range targets you with an attack

vsm: a smear of camphor

desc.desc: You sting the eyes of a creature attacking you. The target must make a CON saving throw. A creature with blindsight or immunity to being blinded succeeds automatically. On a failure, the target is blinded until the end of its turn. On a successful save, it must subtract 1d4 from the triggering attack roll, potentially turning the hit into a miss.
Regardless of success, the target automatically succeeds on its saving throws against your subsequent castings of this spell for 24 hours.

field-of-reaping.name: Field of Reaping
vsm: a dried corn husk, or wheat hull

desc.desc: You create a shadowy field that reaps escaping life force in a 30ft. cube, originating from a point within range. Any creature of your choice in the field when it appears, or when it enters the field for the first time on a its turn, or ends its turn there, is cursed until the end of its next turn. While cursed in this way, the first time the creature takes damage, it takes an extra {*}d6 @necrotic damage, and a creature of your choice that isn't cursed by the field regains a number of hitpoints equal to the damage taken.

ghastly-charge.name: Ghastly Charge
vsm: a scrap of a banner

desc.desc: You call forth the spirits of long-dead knights, which charge forward from you in a 90ft. long, 20ft. wide line, at which point they vanish. Each creature of your choice in the line must make a WIS saving throw, taking {*}d12 @necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. Additionally, on a failure, the target is frightened of you until the start of your next turn, and must immediately use its reaction, if available, to move as far as its speed allows away from you, using the safest route.

harvest-moonglow.name: Harvest Moonglow
vsm: a piece of moonstone

desc.desc: You call upon the light of the harvest moon to illuminate a 20ft. radius sphere centered on a point within range. The area is bathed in silvery, dim light. Invisible creatures and objects in the light become visible as translucent, shimmering images.
As a bonus action, a creature may, if you let it, absorb some of the light, and gain {*}d6 temporary hitpoints.
You inflict a mind-eroding song on a creature you can see within range. If the creature has an INT score of 4 or higher, it must succeed on an INT saving throw, or be charmed by you for the duration.

While charmed in this way, the target is struck with a rapidly repeating ballad that only it can hear. It takes {*}d6 @psychic damage at the start of each of its turns, and it gains disadvantage on Perception (WIS), checks, and on CON saving throws made to maintain concentration. The target may repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

You imbue a weapon you are holding, or your unarmed strikes, with ravenous negative energy. For the duration, whenever you hit a creature with an attack using the empowered weapon for the first time on a turn, the target takes @necrotic damage equal to your spellcasting ability modifier. Additionally, you gain a number of temporary hitpoints equal to the @necrotic damage dealt.

intrusive-despair.name: Intrusive Despair
vsm: a devil's trumpet blossom

desc.desc: You curse a creature within range, filling its mind with creeping paranoia and despair. Whenever the target uses the @attack or @cast a spell actions, it must succeed, it must succeed on a WIS saving throw, or waste its action. Once the target succeeds on the saving throw against this spell three times, the effect ends.

isolation.name: Isolation
vsm: a small metal cube

desc.desc: A creature that you can see within range must succeed on a WIS saving throw, or have its mind shrouded in the dread of total isolation. For the duration, all other creatures are invisible toward the target, which the target cannot see through - even with blindsight, truesight, or magic such as the @see invisibility spell - and the target cannot perceive othere creatures with any of its other senses.

The target moves around other creatures, or otherwise rationalizes not moving through spaces occupied by them (such as perceiving a door as closed, or as a wall if another creature is standing in the way). The target still feels pain, but cannot identify the source of any injury caused by another creature. The target may repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turn, ending the spell on itself on a success.

lucky-charm.name: Lucky Charm
vsm: a four-leaf clover, and a shard of a broken mirror

desc.desc: You touch a Tiny, nonmagical object, infusing it with a portion of your own luck for the duration. While another creature carries the object, that creature gains advantage on ability checks, attack rolls, and saving throws, while you gain disadvantage on them.

martyr.name: Martyr
vsm: a dagger worth at least 1cp

desc.desc: You touch a dead creature that died within the last minute, and transfer your life energy into it. The target returns to life with hitpoints equal to your current hitpoint total.

However, you immediately drop to 0 hitpoints, which nothing can prevent. You instantly gain 2 failed death saving throws, and must immediately make a death save. You cannot regain hitpoints or be stabilized until after you make this save.

mirrored-agony.name: Mirrored Agony

castTime.condition: a creature you can see within range damages a creature not hostile to you

vsm: a pin, or a needle

desc.desc: The attacker must make a WIS saving throw, taking an amount equal to the damage it dealt with the triggering attack @psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.

mist-of-mourning.name: Mist of Mourning
vsm: a vial of tears

desc.desc: You summon a thin mist that saps joy and vigor in a 20ft. radius sphere centered on a point within range. Each creature in the mist when it appears, or when it moves into the mist for the first time on a turn, or ends its turn there, must succeed on a CHA saving throw, or be filled with deep melancholy until the end of its next turn. An affected creature's speed is halved, it gains disadvantage on attack rolls, and it must subtract 1d8 from all its damage rolls.

murder-of-crows.name: Murder of Crows
vsm: a crow feather

desc.desc: You summon and unleash a murder of deadly crows. Each creature of your choice in a 30ft. cone originating from you must make a DEX saving throw, taking {*}d6 @force on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. Additionally, on a failure, a target is blinded. A blinded creature may repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a succes. The effect also ends if the creature regains any number of hitpoints. The crows disperse and vanish after they strike.
You touch a willing creature, and shroud its presence. For the duration, other creatures must subtract 1d4 from any Perception (WIS) and Insight (WIS) checks they make against the target.

puppet-master.name: Puppet Master
vsm: a marionette string

desc.desc: A creature that you can see within range must succeed on a WIS saving throw, or be charmed by you for the duration.

Magical marionette strings attach to the charmed creature's limbs or body. It must use its action on its turn to make a melee attack against a creature other than itself, which you choose mentally, moving to reach the target if necessary. The target may act normally on its turn if you do not choose another creature, or if the creature isn't within the target's reach after it moves.

On subsequent turns, you must use your bonus action to maintain control over the target, or the spell ends early. The target may repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turn, ending the effect on itself on a success.
You touch another creature, and lay a curse that target's vitality, transferring it to you. The target must succeed on a CHA saving throw, or be cursed for the duration.
A creature cursed in this way must subtract 1d4 from its attack rolls and ability checks, and whenever the target takes damage, you may use your reaction to gain 10 temporary hitpoints.
If the target succeeds on the saving throw, you instead gain 5 temporary hitpoints, and the target must subtract 1d4 from its attack rolls and ability checks until the start of your next turn.

sanctum-of-the-shepherd.name: Sanctum of the Shepherd
vsm: adamantine or diamond powder worth at least 200gp, which the spell consumes

desc.desc: You create a 20ft. radius sphere of faint, shimmering light centered on a point within range. You and a number of creatures of your choice up to your spellcasting modifier (minimum of 1) may absorb protective magic from the sphere.

Whenever any of the chosen creatures finish a long rest in the area, the sphere vanishes, and those creatures gain +1 AC for the remainder of the duration. Chosen creatures who do not finish a long rest in the sphere gain no benefit.

sanctum-of-the-flock.name: Sanctum of the Flock
vsm: powdered silver worth at least 25gp, which the spell consumes

desc.desc: You create a 20ft. radius sphere of faint, shimmering light centered on a point within range. You and a number of creatures of your choice up to your spellcasting modifier (minimum of 1) may absorb empowering magic from the sphere.

Whenever any of the chosen creatures finish a long rest in the area, the sphere vanishes, and those creatures gain 2d10 temporary hitpoints. For the remainder for the duration, affected creatures gain advantage on CHA checks that use one of their skill proficiencies.. Chosen creatures who do not finish a long rest in the sphere gain no benefit.

sanguine-secrets.name: Sanguine Secrets
vsm: a drop of blood, which the spell consumes

desc.desc: You draw knowledge through the power of blood about a creature you can see within range.

You learn the target's species and creature type, its current hitpoints, and any conditions affecting it. You also learn if it has any vulnerability, resistances, or immunity to damage, as well as immunities to conditions, and if so, what they are.

Crimson light shines down in a 20ft. radius, 60ft. high cylinder centered on a point within range. Each creature in that area that isn't a construct or undead must make CON saving throw, taking {1}d10 @necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. Constructs and undead instead regain 4d10 hitpoints.
If any of this spell's area overlaps with an area of darkness created by a spell of {2} level or lower, the spell that created the darkness is dispelled.
For the duration, you siphon away the vitality and sense of self through the shadows of creatures within 15ft. of you that aren't behind total cover.

Whenever you cast this spell, you may designate any number of creatures of your choice to be unaffected by it. Whenever any other creature enters the area, or starts its turn there, or when the area enter's a creature's space, the creature must make a CHA saving throw, taking {*}d6 @necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. Additionally, on a failure, the creature gains disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the end of its next turn. A creature makes this save only once per turn.

You unleash a blast of light and wind in a 15ft. cone. Any number of creatures of your choice in the area regain {*}d6 hitpoints. Any number of undead of your choice within the area must make a CON saving throw, taking {*}d6 @radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.

You whisper a frightful phrase to {*} creature(s) you can see within range that only the target(s) can hear. A target must make a WIS saving throw, taking 2d6 @psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. Additionally, on a failure, a target is frightened until the start of your next turn. While frightened in this way, the creature gains vulnerability to one of @bludgeoning, @piercing or @slashing damage, your choice.

veil-of-the-reaper.name: Veil of the Reaper
vsm: a dried corn husk, or wheat straw

desc.desc: You wrap yourself in shadows that veil you between strikes. After hitting a creature with an attack roll, at the end of your turn, you become invisible until the start of your next turn.

bane.name: Bane
vsm: a drop of blood

desc.desc: Up to {*} creatures of your choice that you can see within range must succeed on a CHA saving throw, or, for the duration, whenever it makes an attack roll or a saving throw, subtract 1d4 from the attack roll or saving throw.
Make a melee spell attack against a creature in your reach. On a hit, the target takes {*}d10 necrotic damage.

shillelagh.name: Shillelagh
vsm: mistletoe, a shamrock leaf, and a club or quarterstaff

desc.desc: The wood of a club or quarterstaff you are holding is imbued with nature's power. For the duration, you may use your spellcasting ability instead of STR for the attack and damage rolls of melee attacks using that weapon, and the weapon's damage die becomes 1d8. The weapon also becomes magical, if it isn't already. The spell ends if you cast it again, or if you let go of the weapon.

You channel primal magic to cause your teeth or fingernails to sharpen, ready to deliver a corrosive attack. Make a melee spell attack against a creature within 5ft. of you. On a hit, the target takes {*}d10 @acid damage, at which point your teeth or fingernails return to normal.

ceremony.name: Ceremony
vsm: 25gp worth of powdered silver, which the spell consumes

desc.desc: You perform one of several religious ceremonies. When you cast the spell, choose one of the following ceremonies, the target of which must be within 10ft. of you throughout the casting.

content.name: Atonement
content.desc: You touch a willing creature whose alignment has changed, and you make a DC 20 Insight (WIS) check. On a successful check, you restore the target to its original alignment.

content.name: Bless Water
content.desc: You touch a vial of water and cause it to become holy water.

content.name: Coming of Age
content.desc: You touch a humanoid who is a young adult. For the next 24 hours, whenever the target makes an ability check, it may roll 1d4 and add the number rolled to the ability check. A creature may benefit from this rite only once.

content.name: Dedication
content.desc: You touch a humanoid who wishes to be dedicated to your god's service. For the next 24 hours, whenever the target makes a saving throw, it may roll 1d4 and add the number rolled to the save. A creature may benefit from this rite only once.

content.name: Funeral Rite
content.desc: You touch a corpse, and for the next 7 days, the target cannot become undead by any means short of a @wish spell.

content.name: Wedding
content.desc: You touch adult humanoids willing to be bonded together in marriage. For the next 7 days, each target gains +2 AC while they are within 30ft. of each other. A creature may benefit from this rite again only if widowed.

desc.desc: The next time you hit a creature with a ranged weapon attack before the spell ends, this spell creates a rain of thorns that sprouts from your ranged weapon or ammunition. In addition to the normal effect of the attack, the target of the attack, and each creature within 5ft. of it, must make a DEX saving throw, taking {*}d10 @piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.

mage-armor.name: Mage Armor
vsm: a piece of cured leather

desc.desc: You touch a willing creature who is not wearing armor, and a protective magical force surrounds it until the spell ends. The target's base AC becomes 13 + its DEX. The spell ends if the target dons armor, or if you dismiss the spell as an action.

castTime.condition: you are hit by an attack, or targeted by the @magic missile spell

desc.desc: An invisible barrier of magical force appears and protects you. Until the start of your next turn, you gain +5 AC, including against the triggering attack, and you take no damage from the @magic missile spell.

castTime.condition: a creature you can see within 60ft. succeeds on an attack roll, an ability check, or a saving throw

desc.desc: You magically distract the triggering creature, and turn its momentary uncertainty into encouragement for another creature. The triggering creature must reroll the d20 and use the lower roll. You may then choose a different creature you can see within range, including yourself. The chosen creature gains advantage on the next attack roll, ability check, or saving throw it makes for 1 minute. A creature may be empowered by only 1 use of this spell at a time.

false-life.name: False Life
vsm: a small amount of alcohol, or distilled spirits

desc.desc: Bolstering yourself with a necromantic facsimile of life, you gain 1d4 + {*} temporary hitpoints for the duration.

find-familiar.name: Find Familiar
vsm: 10gp worth of charcoal, incense, and herbs that must be consumed by fire in a brass brazier

desc.desc: You gain the service of a familiar; a spirit that takes an animal form you choose: bat, cat, crab, frog (toad), hawk, lizard, octopus, owl, poisonous snake, fish (quipper), rat, raven, sea horse, spider, or weasel. Appearing in an unoccupied space within range, the familiar has the statistics of the chosen form, though it is a celestial, fey, or fiend, your choice, instead of a beast.

Your familiar acts independently of you, but it always obeys your commands. In combat, it rolls its own initiative and acts on its own turn.
